package rulefixtures

import (
	gorm "gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for gorm_chain_built_in_service: Services that own detailed ORM query shape instead of delegating to repositories.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: warning.
type Rule058PositiveRecord struct {
	ID       int
	TenantID int
	Name     string
}
type Rule058RelatedRecord struct {
	ID       int
	ParentID int
	Detail   string
}

func scenario058Positive(db *gorm.DB, tenantID int) ([]Rule058PositiveRecord, error) {
	var items []Rule058PositiveRecord
	if err := db.Where("tenant_id = ?", tenantID).Preload("Related").Order("created_at DESC").Limit(50).Find(&items).Error; err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return items, nil
}
